checks.paracompact: paracompactSpace_of_properlyDiscontinuousSMul {Γ} [Group Γ] {M} [TopologicalSpace M] [LocallyCompactSpace M] [MulAction Γ M] [ContinuousConstSMul Γ M] [ProperlyDiscontinuousSMul Γ M] (hQ : CompactSpace (orbitRel.Quotient Γ M)) : ParacompactSpace M (pp.explicit: the conclusion is about the ambient topology inst_1, hQ about the quotient topology of the same). Definitions at this pin (#print): ParacompactSpace = every open cover α → Set X has an open, covering, LocallyFinite refinement indexed by some β : Type v (no T2); LocallyCompactSpace = every neighbourhood contains a compact neighbourhood (the strong form; IsCompact is quasi-compactness); ProperlyDiscontinuousSMul = {γ | (γ • K) ∩ L ≠ ∅} finite for compact K, L. Argument checked step by step: K compact meeting every orbit (exists_isCompact_forall_exists_smul_mem, Circle, which uses only exists_compact_mem_nhds and the openness of the orbit map); C compact with K ⊆ U := interior C (exists_compact_superset — this is what removes AUDIT-1's « compact closure », the one place T2 would enter); {g • U} covers (x ∈ γ⁻¹ • U); it is locally finite (compact nbhd N of x, {g | g • C ∩ N ≠ ∅} finite by PD); each g • C is covered by a finite F g ⊆ α; t a := ⋃_{g, a ∈ F g} g • U ∩ s a is open, covers (x ∈ g • U ⊆ g • C ⊆ ⋃_{a ∈ F g} s a), refines (t a ⊆ s a), and is locally finite (N meets t a only for a ∈ ⋃ F g over the finitely many g with g • U ∩ N ≠ ∅); β := α fits the universe of the definition. No hidden separation, no vacuity (PD and cocompactness are satisfiable, and the lemma is used at every divisible factor). The [PD] binder is load-bearing (PGBroken2.lean fails without it). CORRECT AS STATED, and true even with WeaklyLocallyCompactSpace (weak.lean: both this lemma and exists_isCompact_forall_exists_smul_mem re-elaborate with the weak class, standard axioms)
